items.title: Barnes' Notes on the Bible
items.author: Albert Barnes
items.licenseNotes: SermonIndex module sibarnes.conf: DistributionLicense=Public Domain. About names Albert Barnes (1798–1870) and his Notes on the whole Bible. This replaces the CrossWire Barnes module, which was New Testament only. The underlying notes are 19th-century.

items.title: Gill's Exposition of the Entire Bible
items.author: John Gill
items.licenseNotes: SermonIndex SWORD module sigill, DistributionLicense=Public Domain. The download note on the commentary page says “Public domain — free to copy, share and build on.” The underlying exposition is John Gill's 18th-century work. SermonIndex's separate sermon-copying page is about sermons entrusted to that site, not this module.

items.title: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge
items.licenseNotes: CrossWire module TSK, DistributionLicense=Public Domain. Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, about 1880.

items.title: Matthew Henry's Concise Commentary
items.author: Matthew Henry
items.licenseNotes: CrossWire mhcc.conf: DistributionLicense=Public Domain, OSIS zCom version 2.0. Matthew Henry died in 1714; the concise commentary is the long-public abridgement. TextSource names a CCEL cache. The module's About says the Moody Press printing it was checked against displayed no copyright. CCEL's own site files were not downloaded.

items.title: Adam Clarke's Commentary
items.author: Adam Clarke
items.licenseNotes: CrossWire clarke.conf: DistributionLicense=Public Domain, OSIS version 2.0. Adam Clarke (1760/62–1832) finished the commentary in the early nineteenth century. TextSource is the Wikisource transcription, not a CCEL download.

items.title: Calvin's Commentaries
items.author: John Calvin
items.licenseNotes: CrossWire calvincommentaries.conf: DistributionLicense=Public Domain, OSIS version 1.1, Feature=NoParagraphs. John Calvin died in 1564. TextSource names ccel.org; those site files were not downloaded. The module has no Judges through Esther, Job, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Song of Solomon, or Revelation.

items.title: Keil and Delitzsch on the Old Testament
items.author: C. F. Keil and Franz Delitzsch
items.licenseNotes: CrossWire kd.conf: DistributionLicense=Public Domain, OSIS zCom4 version 2.0, Feature=NoParagraphs. Keil (1807–1888) and Delitzsch (1813–1890) published the commentary in 1864. TextSource is https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Biblical_commentary_the_Old_Testament. Old Testament only. There is no separate public-domain CrossWire file besides this Wikisource-based module.

items.title: Wesley's Explanatory Notes
items.author: John Wesley
items.licenseNotes: CrossWire wesley.conf: DistributionLicense=Public Domain, ThML zCom version 1.1, a released module rather than a beta. John Wesley (1703–1791) published the notes in the eighteenth century. The SermonIndex siwesley module is the same work and was not imported twice.

items.title: 1599 Geneva Bible Notes
items.author: Geneva Bible translators
items.licenseNotes: SermonIndex sigeneva.conf: DistributionLicense=Public Domain. About identifies the 1599 Geneva Bible marginal notes, from the 1560 Bible revised in 1599, including notes associated with Theodore Beza. This is not a modern-spelling copyrighted edition. CrossWire's geneva.conf was not used because that file has no DistributionLicense field.

items.title: Scofield Reference Notes (1917)
